caption:
Almost 1 in 5 litres of England's tap water leaks away before it reaches a tap 💧
The Environment Agency's new report says leakage was 18.6% of supply in 2025 to 2026: 2,621 million litres a day, or about 101 litres per property every day. Essex & Suffolk Water lost 11.0%, Thames Water 22.4%. Leakage is down around 12% since 2017–18.

Who do you think leaks the most near you? Comment your town 👇
Source: Environment Agency, Water resources 2025 to 2026 (GOV.UK)
